name: Reverse Z Perspective Projection with Infinite Far Plane
definition: A projection matrix that maps view space to clip space using reverse Z depth buffering and an infinite far plane, improving depth precision near the camera while avoiding far-plane clipping artifacts.
summary: Reverse Z Perspective Projection with Infinite Far Plane is a projection matrix method that inverts depth range and removes far-plane dependency to eliminate clipping artifacts and maintain high precision over large distances.
